attrs.management_says: Revenue grew 7% primarily from Blue Buffalo addition; organic net sales flat (E32, E33, E34).
attrs.numbers_show: Consolidated revenue +7.1% ($15.74B to $16.87B). New Pet segment contributed $1.431B in FY2019 (E51). Other segments: North America Retail -2%, Europe & Australia -5%, Convenience +2%, Asia & Latin America -3% (E41, E44, E46, E48). Organic sales flat per management (E35).

attrs.management_says: Revenue growth of 7% primarily reflects the addition of Blue Buffalo; organic net sales were flat (E32, E33, E34, E35).
attrs.numbers_show: Pet segment (Blue Buffalo) recorded $1,431M net sales in FY2019 (E51) vs $0 in FY2018 (E33, E50). Total revenue rose $1,125M (E1, E12). Other segments declined: North America Retail -2% (E41), Europe & Australia -5% (E46), Convenience Stores & Foodservice +2% (E44), Asia & Latin America -3% (E48). The acquisition more than accounts for the total growth, with organic segments offsetting.

attrs.management_says: Organic net sales flat, with favorable price/mix offset by volume declines across major segments (E35, E41, E42, E44, E46, E47, E49).
attrs.numbers_show: Segment commentary consistently cites price/mix gains offset by volume declines in North America Retail, Europe & Australia, and Convenience Stores & Foodservice; only Asia & Latin America shows organic volume growth (E49). This aligns with flat organic sales and the 7% consolidated growth coming from the Pet segment addition.

attrs.management_says: Consolidated net sales rose 7% to $16.9B, primarily reflecting the addition of Blue Buffalo; organic net sales were essentially flat (E32, E33, E34).
attrs.numbers_show: Pet segment (Blue Buffalo) contributed $1,431M of net sales in FY2019 (E51) vs $0 in FY2018 (one-month lag, E50). Total revenue grew $1,124.8M (E1, E12). Other segments declined: North America Retail -2% (E41), Europe & Australia -5% (E46), Convenience Stores & Foodservice +2% (E44), Asia & Latin America -3% (E48). Organic net sales flat per management (E35) matches segment organic trends (E42, E47, E49).

attrs.management_says: Operations generated $5.6B in cash over the most recent two-year period; we maintained a disciplined focus on cash, resulting in another year of strong free cash flow conversion (E31, E52).
attrs.numbers_show: CFO declined only 1.2% ($2,841.0M → $2,807.0M, E6, E17) despite net income falling 17.8% ($2,131.0M → $1,752.7M, E5, E16). The gap is explained by large non-cash charges (impairments $208M per E38, Blue Buffalo inventory fair-value adjustment $53M per E35, depreciation $620M per E15) and a 34% core working capital reduction (E54) driven by payables extension and lower inventory, which boosts operating cash flow.
